name: smwmusic-ys-iii-wanderers-from-ys-rage-n-bloodshed-a-searing-struggle-remix
title: Ys III: Wanderers from Ys - Rage 'N Bloodshed ~ A Searing Struggle (Remix)
description:
Back at it again with the Ys III remixes after a year of not doing one, and it's A Searing Struggle this time. Heavily based off the Genesis version's "Burning Fight" / PC-88 Version and the PC-Engine CD Version. Similar to the other songs in this OST, this song's SNES version got pretty duped when ported, though I will say the orchestral hit does actually give this version a bit of its own flair. Easily another highlight in this fantastic soundtrack, especially the Genesis, PC-Engine, and Oath in Felghana versions, which are just... way too amazing!!!

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. D Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. E Minor (Famicom Pitch)
